active_blocks: No permission for bulk copying of protected corpora; only bounded non-verbatim paraphrases and locators are stored.
Incoming correspondence is absent from many Igrot Kodesh response cases, so context remains Partial where the incoming question is unavailable.
Underlying manuscript, photograph or secretariat-copy witnesses named by publisher notes were not independently inspected; Verified is scoped to the authorized item-level publisher witness.

Retrieval now has proposition-level relevance gates, topic aliases, claim-local citation entailment checks and a separate researcher evidence map, but ranking remains deterministic and lexical/topic-based rather than a semantic entailment model.
Translated public talks are one manifestation of their dated event; original-language transcripts and recordings must join the same Evidence Family.

www.chabad.org is host-blocked after HTTP 403 responses on the 12-reference GitHub acquisition attempt (2026-10-15 onward). data/acquisition/state.json now marks this host permanent_block; the hourly script must skip network requests and rely on manual public web search or another authorized source.

next_work: Continue Hebrew/Yiddish item-level inspection where public body text is accessible; keep audio-only metadata and publisher shells out of answer evidence.

Expand event-level Evidence Family links when original-language transcripts, audio or video of already indexed talks become available.
Adversarially test proposition relevance, claim-local citation entailment, context boundaries and researcher-mode witness distinctions on both answer modes.
Continue reconciling the live public-search index, metrics and content-readiness test after each content batch.

Continue public-body inspection in Hebrew/Yiddish/English and other documentation types; resolve the Shanghai letter ריג identity only if a direct/authoritative item witness is found; do not retry the blocked runner crawler.
epistemic_rule: No AI inference, reconstruction, or missing context may be represented as the Rebbe's words.

quality_gate.trigger: push to main on source items, answer engine and readiness tests
quality_gate.note: The item-level reconciliation audit confirms seven genuinely new batch-074 AIDs, all selected as answer-eligible in seven distinct Evidence Families. AID 4731080 and AID 4812666 were already canonical in batches 059 and 058; duplicate batch-074 records were removed and the original families retained. Actual counts match the corrected expectation: 764→771 answer-eligible families, 761→768 content-verified families, 2,559→2,580 propositions. The readiness test now asserts seven new items, two existing rechecks, claim-level citations and researcher-mode evidence maps.

primary_user_question: עד כמה אפשר לסמוך על זה?
ux.default_experience: answer-first; technical provenance progressively disclosed; original source opens directly where lawful
ux.answer_model: proposition-grounded multi-source synthesis with high relevance threshold and numbered claim-level citations
ux.regular_mode: concise answer-first synthesis plus numbered evidence list
ux.researcher_mode: extended evidence analysis with subclaims, witness provenance, verification scope, context completeness, source-type/period/audience distinctions, Evidence Families, tensions and unanswered aspects
ux.language_policy: cross-language retrieval across Hebrew, Yiddish, English and any additional direct/authorized source languages; translations are derived, not independent witnesses
ux.precision_policy: precision over recall; lexical-only matches rejected; insufficient evidence is an acceptable result

verification_surge.effort_target: 75-85% promotion/verification until backlog is materially reduced; 15-25% breadth expansion
verification_surge.homogeneous_batch_target: 20-50 records when direct authorized item witnesses are stable and rights permit
blocking_reasons: metadata ambiguity or unresolved identity/dedup conflict

development_recovery.primary_bottleneck: Bibliographic identities are not inspected content; maintenance had no acquisition step and no content inspection.
development_recovery.required_agent_action: Continue original-language Hebrew/Yiddish witnesses and additional document types; treat English translations as non-independent witnesses in their underlying Evidence Families; preserve item-level locators and context limits.
development_recovery.last_run_note: Batch 078 submitted for reconciliation: 12 new public source identities across Hebrew, Yiddish and English; 23 new non-verbatim source-grounded propositions; one existing identity enriched with one proposition; two existing identities rechecked. Twelve alternative candidates redirected to navigation/summary shells and were excluded. No crawler retry, access-control bypass, scan-only verification or full-text copying. Reconciliation and content-readiness tests pending.
development_recovery.last_batch_blocked_reason: 12 candidate pages redirected to summary/navigation shells: 5071144, 4783701, 5054608, 5071147, 4754642, 5100603, 4812647, 4812666, 5100244, 5100662, 4831207, 5357153. They were excluded; alternative public item-level bodies were inspected in the same run.
next_work: Continue manual inspection of 8–15 accessible primary-source bodies per run, expanding to Yiddish and English and to distinct documentary classes where public bodies are available.
Extend claim-level multi-source synthesis and researcher-mode evidence maps to additional high-priority topics, preserving item-local context and limitations.
Keep inaccessible summary/navigation shells excluded and use alternative public publisher items rather than retrying the blocked crawler.
Maintain the existing hourly cron and verify every batch through reconciliation, content-readiness tests and Pages deployment.
